summary: The contract scope applies and HEAD is current. The delivered file name, folder files, SHA-256 values, and page count match the plan. The output-folder guard kept proof, proof-v2, and proof-v3 untouched. The approval records in w02 to w08 match the w01 key set, and no reader in this repository changes behavior except the intended D12 print build. Five nonblocking findings remain: the --print default folder is the approved mock folder, the USAGE text is stale, the hand-off omits the folder path, the folder holds a non-printer cover.pdf, and the approval holds no text SHA link. No blocking finding applies.
